title: Balloon Rally
tagline: Pick a balloon. Ride the wind.
taglineZh: 看准一只气球，跟着它飞。

lines.en: Five paper balloons. Four rounds of wind.

lines.zh: 每轮秘密支持一只气球。
两枚顺风，可以多推一格。

lines.en: Five wind cards decide the race.
Leader scores three. Second scores one. Four rounds, then the overall leader pays five.
lines.zh: 领先支持者得 3 分，第二得 1 分；四轮后总领先再得 5 分。

lines.en: Solo against four AI levels, or 2–6 players on one screen or over Wi-Fi.
lines.zh: 单人四档 AI，或 2–6 人同屏/局域网。

lines.en: Balloon Rally. Five balloons. Four winds. One shared guess.
lines.zh: 气球大赛：五只气球，四轮风，全桌一起猜。
